bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for the Minnesota Board on Aging.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; MINNESOTA BOARD ON AGING.

$1,995,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,071,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for the Minnesota Board on Aging under Minnesota Statutes, section 256.975, to add:

(1) one full-time equivalent position to ensure compliance with federal regulations and assist with providing updates and technical assistance to the seven area agencies on aging and service providers;

(2) one full-time equivalent position to support compliance and policy development for services under the federal Older Americans Act;

(3) two full-time equivalent positions to better support increased service demands and operational needs of the Senior LinkAge Line; and

(4) 18 additional staff positions for the area agencies on aging contact centers to support Senior LinkAge Line operations.

This appropriation is added to the base.
additions: $1,995,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,071,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for the Minnesota Board on Aging under Minnesota Statutes, section 256.975, to add:

(1) one full-time equivalent position to ensure compliance with federal regulations and assist with providing updates and technical assistance to the seven area agencies on aging and service providers;
(2) one full-time equivalent position to support compliance and policy development for services under the federal Older Americans Act;
(3) two full-time equivalent positions to better support increased service demands and operational needs of the Senior LinkAge Line; and
(4) 18 additional staff positions for the area agencies on aging contact centers to support Senior LinkAge Line operations.
This appropriation is added to the base.
